pr_title: fix(expect): report expect "Timed out" when it actually does
pr_body:
Previously, it would say "Timed out" when page was closed at test timeout, or not say "Timed out" when at least one element matched.

Fixes #21664.

issue_context.title: [BUG] Misleading expect timeout in reports
comments: @jaktestowac I see the message "Test timeout of 5000ms exceeded" on your screenshot. Do you expect something else?

@dgozman in the case of first line the output is correct. Next lines contains incorrect info. 
`Error: Timed out 7000ms waiting for expect(received).toBeEnabled()`
`- expect.toBeEnabled with timeout 7000ms`
Is not possible that wait for expect last more than test timeout (5000ms). And that information about expect timeout is presented twice (timeout 7000ms) what lead to confusion.
